item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Leaves `metric_threshold` unset and uses a metric that always returns `0.1`, so it exercises the no-threshold acceptance path."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Runs the same `0.1` metric with `metric_threshold=0.5`, which is above `0.1` and therefore tests rejection under thresholded acceptance."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `max_labeled_demos=0` and `max_bootstrapped_demos=1`, isolating bootstrap acceptance in `predictor.demos` and capping accepted demos at one."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Compiles the same module twice, compares demo counts, and asserts `1` without a threshold versus `0` with the stricter threshold."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
